title: Where There's a Will
subtitle: A Deadly Legacy and a Reluctant Summons
summary: A routine morning is shattered when detective Byomkesh Bakshi receives a call summoning him to investigate a murder—one that even the Deputy Commissioner is reluctant to handle. As Byomkesh steps into an uneasy partnership, secrets and rivalries hint at a case where nothing is as straightforward as it seems. Dive into a classic mystery where sharp wit and hidden motives collide.
